highlights.title_zh: EEGPrep 修 ASR 两个边界 bug：chunk 末尾漏更新与 NaN lookahead 丢失
highlights.title_en: EEGPrep Fixes Two ASR Boundary Bugs: Missed Chunk-End Update and Lost NaN Lookahead
highlights.brief: EEGPrep（EEGLAB 预处理流程的 Python 实现）在 11-04 连修两个 ASR 边界 bug：**#525** 当 chunk 长度对 step 取余为 1 时，`asr_process` 在**最后一个样本上没有刷新重建**，等于漏掉该点校正；**#529** 让 `clean_asr` 反射的数组**保留原始 NaN**——此前 `asr_calibrate` 会把非有限样本清零、`clean_asr` 在关闭参考选择时又共享录制，于是 lookahead 校准建立在被改动过的数据上。两处都属于「不报错、只让结果和 MATLAB 版不一致」的类型，而 ASR 恰恰是很多流程里最重的一步。对做 EEGLAB→Python 迁移或跨实现比对的团队，建议升级后用同一份数据两端各跑一次 ASR，逐通道比对残差。

highlights.title_zh: MNE-Python 修四元数转换的边界 bug（影响坐标/头部变换）
highlights.title_en: MNE-Python Fixes a Corner-Case Quaternion Conversion Bug Affecting Transforms
highlights.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14492：修 **四元数转换的边界 bug**，复现路径用官方 sample 数据集加 `pick_info`。四元数负责表达头位与设备坐标系之间的旋转，这类转换在边界情况出错时**不会报错**，只会让坐标解释偏一点——通常在配准、正向建模或源定位阶段才表现为「怎么对都对不上」，排查成本极高。同日还修了 `stc.save` 的格式推断与重复扩展名问题（#1315x），属写入健壮性。对做 MEG/EEG 源定位的团队，建议升级后跑一次 `get_head_mri_trans`/配准流程并核对变换矩阵；如果你有历史数据是经过 `pick_info` 再算头的，值得抽查。

highlights.title_zh: Brainstorm 支持 NIRS 体积头模，并修多设备 Optode 名称读取
highlights.title_en: Brainstorm Adds NIRS Volume Head Models and Fixes Optode Names Across Artinis Devices
highlights.brief: Brainstorm 在 11-04 推进 4 个提交，两条对 fNIRS 用户很实际：**#955 支持 NIRS 体积头模**（把 fNIRS 敏感性分布映射到体积网格，而不只是表面/皮层），**#959 修多台 Artinis 设备时 Optode 名称读取错误**——多设备同步记录的通道标签一旦错位，后续所有分组分析都会跟着错，而这类错误在数据里看不出来，只会在结果「怎么都不合理」时才被怀疑。同批还有 MCXlab 更新到 v2026 与教程里 Scout ICC reshape 的修正。对做 fNIRS 超扫描或多设备采集的团队，建议升级后核对一遍 optode 标签与设备序列号的对应关系。

items.title_zh: EEGPrep 修 ASR 两个边界 bug：chunk 末尾漏更新与 NaN lookahead 丢失
items.title_en: EEGPrep Fixes Two ASR Boundary Bugs: Missed Chunk-End Update and Lost NaN Lookahead
bullets_zh: #525：当 chunk 长度对 step 取余为 1 时，`asr_process`/`asr_process_r` **在最后一个样本上没有刷新重建**，会漏掉该点的校正。
#529：`clean_asr` 反射数组里**应保留原始 NaN**，此前 `asr_calibrate` 会把非有限样本清零、`clean_asr` 又在关闭参考选择时共享录制——lookahead 校准因此建立在被改动过的数据上。
ASR 是自动伪迹子空间重建的核心步骤，这类边界/NaN 处理差异会让 Python 与 MATLAB 版本结果不一致。
bullets_en: #525 fixes asr_process and asr_process_r missing the reconstruction refresh on a chunk's last sample when the chunk length modulo step is 1.

#529 keeps the original NaNs in the array clean_asr reflects, since asr_calibrate zeroes non-finite samples on a copy-on-write argument and clean_asr shares the recording when reference selection is off — the lookahead calibration was built on altered data.
ASR is the core of automatic subspace reconstruction, and such boundary/NaN differences make Python and MATLAB results diverge.
items.brief: EEGPrep（EEGLAB 预处理流程的 Python 实现）在 11-04 连修两个 ASR 边界 bug：**#525** 当 chunk 长度对 step 取余为 1 时，`asr_process` 在**最后一个样本上没有刷新重建**，等于漏掉该点校正；**#529** 让 `clean_asr` 反射的数组**保留原始 NaN**——此前 `asr_calibrate` 会把非有限样本清零、`clean_asr` 在关闭参考选择时又共享录制，于是 lookahead 校准建立在被改动过的数据上。两处都属于「不报错、只让结果和 MATLAB 版不一致」的类型，而 ASR 恰恰是很多流程里最重的一步。对做 EEGLAB→Python 迁移或跨实现比对的团队，建议升级后用同一份数据两端各跑一次 ASR，逐通道比对残差。
items.brief_en: EEGPrep fixed two ASR boundary bugs on Nov 4: #525 — asr_process missed the reconstruction refresh on a chunk's last sample when the chunk length modulo step is 1; #529 — clean_asr now keeps the original NaNs it reflects, since asr_calibrate zeroed non-finite samples and clean_asr shared the recording, building lookahead calibration on altered data. Both silently diverge from the MATLAB version.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #525: "Fix the missed ASR update on a chunk's last sample — asr_process and asr_process_r now refresh the reconstruction on the last sample when the chunk length modulo the step is 1…" 21:00Z. PR #529: "Keep ASR lookahead on the original NaN samples — Keep NaNs in the array clean_asr reflects. … asr_calibrate.m:169 zeros non-finite samples on a copy-on-write argument, clean_asr.m:157 shares the recording when reference selection is off" 21:23Z.
items.why_valuable: ASR 的 chunk 边界与 NaN lookahead 差异会让 Python 与 MATLAB 结果不一致且不报错。

items.title_zh: MNE-Python 修四元数转换的边界 bug（影响坐标/头部变换）
items.title_en: MNE-Python Fixes a Corner-Case Quaternion Conversion Bug Affecting Transforms
bullets_zh: #14492：修 `pick_info` 之后**四元数转换**的边界情况——用一个具体的 sample MEG 数据集复现，属坐标/头部位置变换类问题。
四元数用于表示头位与设备间旋转；转换错一个边界情况会让整段数据的坐标解释偏移，且往往在配准或源定位阶段才暴露。
同日 #1315x 还修了 `stc.save` 的「推断格式并避免重复扩展名」，属文件写入健壮性。
bullets_en: #14492 fixes a corner case in quaternion conversion after pick_info, reproduced on the sample MEG dataset — a coordinate and head-position transform issue.
Quaternions encode rotations between head and device frames; a wrong corner case shifts how coordinates are interpreted, usually surfacing late in coregistration or source localisation.
The same day fixed stc.save inferring the file format and avoiding duplicated extensions, a file-writing robustness issue.
items.brief: MNE-Python 合并 #14492：修 **四元数转换的边界 bug**，复现路径用官方 sample 数据集加 `pick_info`。四元数负责表达头位与设备坐标系之间的旋转，这类转换在边界情况出错时**不会报错**，只会让坐标解释偏一点——通常在配准、正向建模或源定位阶段才表现为「怎么对都对不上」，排查成本极高。同日还修了 `stc.save` 的格式推断与重复扩展名问题（#1315x），属写入健壮性。对做 MEG/EEG 源定位的团队，建议升级后跑一次 `get_head_mri_trans`/配准流程并核对变换矩阵；如果你有历史数据是经过 `pick_info` 再算头的，值得抽查。
items.brief_en: MNE-Python merged #14492 fixing a corner-case quaternion conversion bug, reproduced with the sample MEG dataset plus pick_info. Quaternions encode rotations between head and device frames, and a wrong edge case shifts coordinate interpretation without any error, usually surfacing as irreconcilable coregistration or source localisation. stc.save format inference was also fixed the same day.
items.raw_excerpt: PR #14492 "Fix bug with quaternion conversion": "fixes a corner-case bug… import mne; fname = mne.datasets.sample.data_path() / \"MEG\" / \"sample\" / \"sample_audvis_raw.fif\"; info = mne.io.read_info(fname); info = mne.pick_info(info, mne.pick_channels(…" Merged 2026-11-04T19:01Z. Same day: "FIX: Infer file format and avoid duplicate extensions in stc.save (#1315…)" 20:22Z.
items.why_valuable: 四元数边界错会让坐标系解释偏移，往往到配准/源定位才暴露。

items.title_zh: Brainstorm 支持 NIRS 体积头模，并修多设备 Optode 名称读取
items.title_en: Brainstorm Adds NIRS Volume Head Models and Fixes Optode Names Across Artinis Devices
bullets_zh: **#955**：在 NIRSTORM 上支持 **NIRS 体积头模**（此前更多是表面/皮层层面），便于把 fNIRS 敏感性分布映射到体积网格。
**#959**：修「**多台 Artinis 设备**」时 Optode 名称读取错误——多设备记录的通道标签错位会让后续分组分析全错。
同批还更新 MCXlab 到 v2026 并修教程里 Scout ICC 值的 reshape 问题。
bullets_en: #955 adds NIRS volume head models on NIRSTORM, so fNIRS sensitivity can be mapped onto volumetric grids rather than only surface or cortical space.
#959 fixes optode name reading with multiple Artinis devices; mislabelled channels in multi-device recordings corrupt every downstream group analysis.
The batch also updates MCXlab to v2026 and fixes a Scout ICC reshape bug in a tutorial.
items.brief: Brainstorm 在 11-04 推进 4 个提交，两条对 fNIRS 用户很实际：**#955 支持 NIRS 体积头模**（把 fNIRS 敏感性分布映射到体积网格，而不只是表面/皮层），**#959 修多台 Artinis 设备时 Optode 名称读取错误**——多设备同步记录的通道标签一旦错位，后续所有分组分析都会跟着错，而这类错误在数据里看不出来，只会在结果「怎么都不合理」时才被怀疑。同批还有 MCXlab 更新到 v2026 与教程里 Scout ICC reshape 的修正。对做 fNIRS 超扫描或多设备采集的团队，建议升级后核对一遍 optode 标签与设备序列号的对应关系。
items.brief_en: Brainstorm made four commits on Nov 4 with two practical for fNIRS: #955 adds NIRS volume head models, mapping fNIRS sensitivity onto volumetric grids, and #959 fixes optode name reading with multiple Artinis devices — mislabelled channels in multi-device recordings corrupt every downstream analysis and are invisible in the data. MCXlab was updated to v2026.
items.raw_excerpt: PRs merged 2026-11-04: "Headmodel: NIRS, volume head models supported on NIRSTORM (#955)" 20:36Z; "IO: Fix reading optode names for multiple Artinis devices (#959)" 17:20Z; "Plugin: Update MCXlab to latest release (v.2026) (#958)" 16:57Z; "Bugfix: Tutorial brain_fingerprint, reshaping Scout ICC values" 16:51Z.
items.why_valuable: 多设备 optode 标签错位会毁掉全部分组分析，且数据里看不出来。

items.title_zh: eegnet-events：用 EEGNet 分类眨眼/扫视/无事件，并支持弃权与事件合并
items.title_en: eegnet-events: EEGNet for Blinks, Saccades and Quiet Windows, With Abstention
bullets_zh: 目标是把**眨眼、任意方向扫视、安静注视窗口**分开，基于 **EEGEyeNet DOTS** 记录、取 14 个 EGI 电极做几何近似。
后处理阶段可**校准置信度、对不确定窗口弃权**，并把滑窗判定合并成「事件片段」——比逐窗输出更贴近实际使用。
对眼电伪迹处理是实用思路：与其一律剔除，不如先分类再决定保留/校正/剔除。
bullets_en: It separates blinks, saccades in any direction and quiet fixation windows, built on EEGEyeNet DOTS recordings with 14 EGI electrodes as a geometric approximation.
A post-processing stage calibrates confidence, abstains on uncertain windows and groups sliding-window decisions into event episodes, closer to real use than per-window outputs.
A practical stance on ocular artefacts: classify first, then decide whether to keep, correct or reject, instead of rejecting everything.
items.brief: 新建仓库 eegnet-events（2026-11-04）处理的是 EEG 里最恼人也最常被粗暴处理的东西——**眼电事件**：用 EEGNet 区分**眨眼、任意方向扫视与安静注视**，数据基于 **EEGEyeNet DOTS**，取 14 个 EGI 电极做几何近似。亮点在后处理：可以**校准置信度、对不确定窗口弃权**，并把滑窗判定合并成「事件片段」——这比逐窗输出贴近真实使用，也避免「模型硬给一个标签」的过度自信。对做眼电校正的团队，它的价值是提供另一种思路：**先分类再决定保留/校正/剔除**，而不是一律抹掉。注意它用的是特定设备与电极子集，迁移到别的蒙太奇需重新验证。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-11-04, eegnet-events classifies blinks, saccades in any direction and quiet fixation windows with EEGNet on EEGEyeNet DOTS recordings, using 14 EGI electrodes as a geometric approximation. Post-processing calibrates confidence, abstains on uncertain windows and merges decisions into episodes — a practical alternative to blanket rejection, though other montages need revalidation.
items.raw_excerpt: README: "Classify blinks, saccades of any direction, and quiet fixation windows. A separate post-processing stage can calibrate confidence, abstain on uncertain windows, and group sliding-window decisions into event episodes." "This is a research pipeline for **EEGEyeNet DOTS recordings**, using 14 selected EGI electrodes as a geometric approximation".
items.why_valuable: 先分类眼电事件再决定保留/校正/剔除，比一律剔除更可解释且支持弃权。

items.title_zh: FPGA 脑电康复原型（Zynq7020，中文）：2026 全国大学生嵌入式大赛作品
items.title_en: An FPGA EEG Rehabilitation Prototype on Zynq7020: A Chinese Student Competition Entry
bullets_zh: 基于 **Alientek Navigator Zynq7020（xc7z020clg400-2）＋ PetaLinux 2020.2 ARMv7** 与 Vivado 2025.2，完成**运动想象识别与显示**，用于辅助医生做手部抓握康复。
作者明确当前范围：**已完成识别与显示**，康复辅助仍由医生主导——不是闭环刺激或自主康复系统。
与近期收录的 FPSoC 方案（DR1M90G-BCI）并列，可对比「ARM＋PL 分工」在边缘 BCI 里的两种落地方式。
bullets_en: Built on an Alientek Navigator Zynq7020 (xc7z020clg400-2) with PetaLinux 2020.2 ARMv7 and Vivado 2025.2, it performs motor-imagery recognition and display to assist clinicians with hand-grasp rehabilitation.
The author is explicit about scope: recognition and display are done, while the rehabilitation itself stays clinician-led rather than being a closed-loop or self-directed system.
It sits alongside the recent FPSoC entry (DR1M90G-BCI) as two ways of splitting work between ARM and programmable logic for edge BCI.
items.brief: 新建仓库 fpga_eeg_rehab（2026-11-04，中文）：**2026 全国大学生嵌入式大赛**参赛作品（AMD 自选组初级赛道），基于 **Zynq7020（xc7z020clg400-2）＋ PetaLinux 2020.2 ARMv7** 与 Vivado 2025.2，实现**运动想象识别与显示**，用于辅助医生进行手部抓握康复。作者把范围写得很清楚：**当前完成的是识别与显示**，康复过程仍由医生主导，不是闭环刺激或自主训练系统——这种边界说明比夸大功能更可信。它与此前收录的安路 FPSoC 方案（DR1M90G-BCI）恰好构成对照：同样是「ARM 负责流程、PL 负责推理」，一个用 Zynq 生态、一个用国产 FPSoC。对做嵌入式 BCI 的学生团队，两份工程都值得当参考模板。
items.brief_en: Created 2026-11-04, fpga_eeg_rehab is a 2026 Chinese embedded-systems competition entry (AMD track) on a Zynq7020 with PetaLinux and Vivado, performing motor-imagery recognition and display to assist clinician-led hand-grasp rehabilitation. The author is explicit that only recognition and display are complete — not a closed loop — pairing with the Anlogic FPSoC entry as two ARM/PL splits.
items.raw_excerpt: 「2026 全国大学生嵌入式大赛参赛作品--AMD自选组初级赛道 报名作品：基于FPGA脑电辅助手康复设备。当前完成识别与显示，辅助医生进行手部抓握康复。」「硬件与设备信息 Alientek Navigator Zynq7020, xc7z020clg400-2; PetaLinux2020.2 ARMv7 hard-float. Vivado2025.2」
items.why_valuable: Zynq 上完成识别+显示并明确边界，与安路 FPSoC 方案构成 ARM/PL 分工对照。

items.title_zh: NeuroRVQ（NeurIPS 2026）：多尺度生物信号 tokenization 的生成式基础模型代码
items.title_en: NeuroRVQ (NeurIPS 2026): Code for Multi-Scale Biosignal Tokenization in Generative Foundation Models
bullets_zh: 主题是**多尺度生物信号 tokenization**，面向生成式基础模型——把连续生理信号离散成 token 是「用语言模型范式做 EEG」的关键一步。
本次为 **Code v1 Release Fixes**：同批修正发布版代码，配有 NeurIPS 2026 徽章与 arXiv 2510.13068v4 链接。
对想做 EEG 生成/自监督的团队，tokenizer 设计直接决定重建质量与下游可用性，值得对照实现细节。
bullets_en: The topic is multi-scale biosignal tokenization for generative foundation models — turning continuous physiological signals into tokens is the key step in applying language-model paradigms to EEG.
This commit is Code v1 Release Fixes, shipping the release code with a NeurIPS 2026 badge and arXiv 2510.13068v4 link.
For EEG generative or self-supervised work, tokenizer design decides reconstruction quality and downstream usability, so implementation details matter.
items.brief: NeuroRVQ 在 11-04 推送 **Code v1 Release Fixes**（NeurIPS 2026 论文配套代码，arXiv 2510.13068v4）：主题是**多尺度生物信号 tokenization**，为生成式基础模型服务。把连续生理信号离散成 token 是「用语言模型范式处理 EEG」的核心环节——tokenizer 的粒度、码本与多尺度设计直接决定重建质量，也决定下游微调能不能用得上。对做 EEG 生成建模或自监督预训练的团队，这类官方实现值得对照阅读；但请注意这是 **v1 修复版**，接口与脚本可能仍会变，复现实验前建议先固定 commit 并记录环境。
items.brief_en: NeuroRVQ pushed Code v1 Release Fixes on Nov 4 (NeurIPS 2026, arXiv 2510.13068v4): multi-scale biosignal tokenization for generative foundation models. Turning continuous signals into tokens is the core step in applying language-model paradigms to EEG, and tokenizer granularity, codebook and multi-scale design decide reconstruction quality and downstream usability. Pin the commit first.
items.raw_excerpt: README: "NeuroRVQ: Multi-Scale Biosignal Tokenization for Generative Foundation Models" — badges "NeurIPS 2026" and arXiv "2510.13068v4". Commit d2061c7b1b, 2026-11-04T11:32Z: "Code v1 Release Fixes".
items.why_valuable: tokenizer 粒度与码本决定重建质量和下游可用性，官方实现值得对照。

items.title_zh: autoreject 提速旧版 Bayesian 与老 MNE 代码路径
items.title_en: autoreject Speeds Up the Legacy Bayesian and Old-MNE Code Paths
bullets_zh: #369：优化**旧版 Bayesian 接口**与**老 MNE 兼容路径**的性能——这些路径仍在被既有脚本调用，不能只优化新 API。
与前一天 #368（改用新插值 API 并获得小幅加速）形成互补：一条走新路、一条兜旧路，覆盖升级过渡期的真实使用。
对尚未升级 MNE 或仍用 `Bayesian` 老接口的流水线，这是直接收益。
bullets_en: #369 optimises the legacy Bayesian interface and the old-MNE compatibility path — routes that existing scripts still call, so optimising only the new API would miss them.
It complements the previous day's #368 (adopting the new interpolation API with a modest gain): one takes the new road, one smooths the old one, covering the upgrade transition.
For pipelines still on older MNE or the legacy Bayesian interface, this is a direct gain.
items.brief: autoreject 合并 #369：优化**旧版 Bayesian 接口**与**老 MNE 兼容路径**的性能。这条容易被忽略但很务实——多数优化都盯着新 API，可真实世界里仍有大量脚本跑在旧接口上（尚未升级 MNE 的项目尤其多），不管这些路径等于把一半用户留在原地。它与前一天 #368（改用新插值 API、59 通道 EEG 从 1.969 s 到 1.880 s）形成互补：一条走新路，一条兜旧路，正好覆盖升级过渡期。对尚未迁移的流水线，建议升级后对比一次剔除结果，确认加速没有改变判定。
items.brief_en: autoreject merged #369 optimising the legacy Bayesian interface and the old-MNE compatibility path. Most optimisation targets the new API, yet many real scripts still run on the old one; it complements the previous day's #368 which took the new interpolation API. Pipelines that have not migrated should compare rejection results after upgrading to confirm speed did not change decisions.
items.raw_excerpt: Commit 190c7669f7, 2026-11-04T19:50Z: "Speed up old Bayesian and old-mne code paths (#369)". Preceding day: "Use new API for interpolation when available (#368)".
items.why_valuable: 仍有大量脚本跑在旧接口上，兜旧路径才是过渡期真实收益。
